evidence.why: Complete guard, switch, latch and callback writes.

facts.rationale: Preserves the unmatched-kind branch and distinguishes the guarded latch write from unconditional callback setup and retirement.
facts.value: Obtains Fighter from gobj->user_data. When x2219_b0 is clear, reads fighter kind and spawns effect 1266 for kind 18 or 1297 for kind 26 using gobj and fp->parts->joint; other kinds spawn nothing. It then sets x2219_b0 regardless of whether the switch matched. When already latched, kind lookup and spawning are skipped. Every path assigns effect pause/resume hitlag callbacks and clears accessory4_cb.
